That is the current recorded decision (#28), and it replaced an earlier license decision that has since been retired. I left the retired one out of the file, as you asked. I didn't change the repository's `LICENSE` file, so it may not match the recorded decision.

The first attempt at creating the file failed in the shell, so I wrote it with the file-write tool instead.
